name: security-sidecar
description: Claude Code plugins that document and check the protection intent of web routes.

plugins.name: security-sidecar
plugins.description: Documents each web route's protection intent in a .route.json sidecar, so that even if the AI misses something, it can still be caught. Flags code that drifts from that intent, such as a removed authentication check. Annotate-only by default.
